Star Bulk Carriers Corp. provides international seaborne transportation services for dry bulk commodities. The company transports major bulk cargoes, including iron ore, minerals, and grain, as well as minor bulks such as bauxite, fertilizers, and steel products. As of September 4, 2026, the company owned a fleet of 138 dry bulk vessels consisting of Newcastlemax, Capesize, Post Panamax, Kamsarmax, Ultramax, and Supramax vessels aggregate carrying capacity of 13,750,243 dead weight tonnage. Star Bulk Carriers Corp. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Maroussi, Greece.
